name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Infused Preroll | Blue Dream
description:
Crafted with premium sativa flower and infused with terpene-rich live resin, this 1.2G pre-roll delivers amplified potency, bold berry flavor, and an energetic lift. Designed for daytime smokers and high-tolerance consumers looking for strong cerebral impact.

Strain: Blue Dream (Sativa)

Infusion: Full-spectrum Live Resin

Total Weight: 1.2g

Aroma: Sweet blueberry, bright herbal haze, subtle creamy undertone

Flavor: Berry-forward inhale with light floral notes and smooth citrus-diesel finish

Effects: Fast-acting cerebral boost, creative focus, steady daytime energy

Experience: Thick smoke output, slow even burn, elevated terpene punch
